sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但她的身份确认，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: On Monday the 23rd of May 1994, a violent storm hit the city of Perth, Western Australia.
sentences.zh: 1994年5月23日，星期一，一场猛烈的风暴袭击了西澳大利亚州的珀斯市。

sentences.en: Peter Lawrence was at home with one of his daughters.
sentences.zh: 彼得·劳伦斯当时正和他的一个女儿待在家里。

sentences.en: He was concerned.
sentences.zh: 他感到很担心。

sentences.en: It was getting late and his wife Pamela Lawrence hadn't gotten home from work yet
sentences.zh: 天色已晚，他的妻子帕梅拉·劳伦斯还没下班回家。

sentences.en: He called her store at 6.15pm
sentences.zh: 他在下午6点15分给她的店里打了电话。

sentences.en: When he didn't get an answer, he decided he had better go down and check on her
sentences.zh: 当没人接听时，他决定最好亲自去店里看看她。

sentences.en: Andrew Mallard was born on the 16th of August 1962
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·马拉德出生于1962年8月16日。

sentences.en: His parents were Roy and Grace Mallard
sentences.zh: 他的父母是罗伊和格蕾丝·马拉德。

sentences.en: Andrew was born in England where his father Roy had a long career in the army
sentences.zh: 安德鲁出生在英国，他的父亲罗伊曾在军队长期服役。

sentences.en: The Mallards were a hard-working, well-respected and law-abiding family
sentences.zh: 马拉德一家勤劳、受人尊敬且遵纪守法。

sentences.en: Andrew also had an older sister, Jackie, who was 10 years older than him
sentences.zh: 安德鲁还有一个比他大10岁的姐姐，名叫杰基。

sentences.en: The Mallards left England in 1967 and moved to Perth in Western Australia
sentences.zh: 马拉德一家于1967年离开英国，搬到了西澳大利亚州的珀斯。

sentences.en: Andrew had difficulty fitting into his new country
sentences.zh: 安德鲁很难融入这个新国家。

sentences.en: He was exceptionally tall for his age and that, combined with his English accent, was good enough to make him a target for bullies
sentences.zh: 他比同龄人高出许多，再加上他的英国口音，这让他成了霸凌者的目标。

sentences.en: kids would mimic his accent call him lots of colorful names and someone as far as to attack
sentences.zh: 孩子们会模仿他的口音，给他起各种难听的外号，甚至有人对他进行身体攻击。

sentences.en: him physically Andrew never felt like he belonged high school was even worse Andrew being the type
sentences.zh: 安德鲁从未感到自己属于这里。高中生活更糟糕，安德鲁属于那种霸凌者觉得可以放心欺负的孩子，因为他们知道他不会还手。

sentences.en: of kid that bullies could feel safe in hitting because they knew he wouldn't hit back Andrew
sentences.zh: 安德鲁在16岁时辍学，没有计划，也没有职业方向。18岁时，安德鲁开始混迹夜店。

sentences.en: left school at 16 with no plans or career path in mind when he turned 18 Andrew started hitting the nightclub scene.
sentences.zh: 那时他已经长到了六英尺六英寸（约1.98米）高。

sentences.en: He was now a six foot six inch tall adult.
sentences.zh: 他在人群中非常显眼。

sentences.en: He definitely stood out in the crowd.
sentences.zh: 正是夜店生活让他接触到了大麻，很快他就开始频繁吸食。

sentences.en: It was the nightclub scene that introduced him to marijuana and he was soon smoking it regularly.
sentences.zh: 他的父母并不赞同安德鲁的生活方式。

sentences.en: His parents didn't approve of where Andrew was heading in life.
sentences.zh: 他身无分文，失业在家。

sentences.en: He was broke, unemployed and living at home.
sentences.zh: 于是他决定做一件他认为能让父母刮目相看的事。

sentences.en: So he decided to do something he thought would impress them.
sentences.zh: 他报名参军，但他并不适合军队生活。

sentences.en: He enlisted in the army but he wasn't cut out for it.
sentences.zh: 他没能通过基础训练。

sentences.en: He never made it through basic training.
sentences.zh: 反而因为轻微的睡眠障碍被准予病退。

sentences.en: instead being offered a medical discharge due to a mild sleeping disorder.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁回到珀斯，又回到了以前混夜店、抽大麻的老路。

sentences.en: Andrew returned back to Perth and got back to his old nightclubbing and dope smoking ways.
sentences.zh: 他感到迷茫，生活失去了目标。

sentences.en: He felt lost in life without a purpose.
sentences.zh: 他坚信自己不属于澳大利亚，便缠着父母给他买回英国的机票，但他在那里也没什么作为。

sentences.en: Convinced he didn't belong in Australia, he pestered his parents to buy him an airfare back to England but he didn't do much good over
sentences.zh: 没过多久，他的父母又不得不掏钱买机票把他接回珀斯。

sentences.en: there either and it wasn't long before his parents were paying for an airfare to get him back home to Perth.
sentences.zh: 到了这个阶段，安德鲁已经处于彻底崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: By this stage, Andrew was on the verge of a complete breakdown.
sentences.zh: 他不敢出门，因为他开始遭受极度的焦虑和恐慌发作。

sentences.en: He couldn't go outside because he started suffering from extreme anxiety and panic attacks.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲罗伊送他去看心理医生，他每周都会去见医生，持续了几个月。

sentences.en: His father, Roy, sent him to a psychologist, who he met with every week for a few months.
sentences.zh: 这确实帮助他开始重回正轨。

sentences.en: It really helped him start to get back on track.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁停止了吸食大麻，感觉自己准备好搬出去，重新面对世界了。

sentences.en: Andrew stopped smoking pot and he felt like he was ready to move out and face the world again.
sentences.zh: 他搬进了南珀斯的一处合租房。

sentences.en: He moved into a shared accommodation place in South Perth.
sentences.zh: 但他新获得的乐观情绪并没有持续多久，因为他在几次求职面试中都失败了。

sentences.en: But his newfound optimism was short-lived when he was unsuccessful at a number of job interviews.
sentences.zh: 当他的室友点燃一支大麻烟时，安德鲁没能抵挡住旧习的诱惑。

sentences.en: When one of his housemates lit up a joint, Andrew couldn't resist his old habit.
sentences.zh: 几个月内，他就变得身无分文、无家可归，在珀斯的街头流浪。

sentences.en: Within a few months, he was broke and homeless, wandering the streets of Perth.
sentences.zh: 1994年5月，安德鲁认识了一个叫米歇尔的女孩。

sentences.en: In May 1994, Andrew met a girl named to Michelle.
sentences.zh: 他立刻被她吸引了。

sentences.en: He was instantly attracted to her.
sentences.zh: 虽然米歇尔对他没那种感觉，但她还是允许安德鲁睡在她的沙发上。

sentences.en: The feeling wasn't mutual, but Michelle did allow
sentences.zh: 他简直不敢相信自己的运气。

sentences.en: Andrew to sleep on her lounge.
sentences.zh: 一位迷人的女性收留了他。

sentences.en: He couldn't believe his luck.
sentences.zh: 她住在莫斯曼公园区格莱德街附近的一间公寓里。

sentences.en: An attractive woman was taking him in.
sentences.zh: 然而不到一周，安德鲁就招人嫌了。

sentences.en: She lived in a flat just off Glide Street in Mosman Park.
sentences.zh: 每当米歇尔暗示他该搬走时，安德鲁就会想尽办法为她弄来大麻。

sentences.en: It took less than a week for Andrew to outstay his welcome though.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔喜欢抽大麻，当她吸嗨了之后，关于让他搬走的话题也就停止了。

sentences.en: Whenever Michelle started hinting it might be time for him to move on, Andrew did whatever he could to find her some marijuana.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔甚至不知道安德鲁的真名。

sentences.en: Michelle loved to smoke, and when she was stoned, the talk about him moving out stopped.
sentences.zh: 她以为安德鲁是一个叫“安德烈”的英国背包客，只是在等待从英国汇款过来期间需要个落脚的地方。

sentences.en: Michelle didn't even know Andrew's real name.
sentences.zh: 那个谎言没能维持多久，因为米歇尔在他的背包里发现了一份简历。

sentences.en: She believed Andrew was an English backpacker named Andre, who just needed somewhere to crash while he waited for some money to be transferred from England.
sentences.zh: 但安德鲁并不打算说出真相。

sentences.en: That story didn't last long because
sentences.zh: 他声称自己其实是国际刑警组织的特工，正在努力捣毁弗里曼特尔的一个有组织犯罪集团。

sentences.en: Michelle found a copy of his resume in his backpack.
sentences.zh: 他的真名是迈克尔·法拉第。

sentences.en: But Andrew wasn't about to tell his real story.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·马拉德的简历只是他的掩护身份。

sentences.en: He said he was really an agent from Interpol, working to break an organised crime syndicate in Fremantle.
sentences.zh: 显然，米歇尔相信了这个故事。

sentences.en: His real name was Michael Faraday.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁当时正处于躁狂发作期。

sentences.en: The resume for Andrew Mallard was part of his cover.
sentences.zh: 他的状态正在失控。

sentences.en: Apparently, Michelle bought the story.
sentences.zh: 由于他日益古怪的行为，他已经引起了当地警方的注意。

sentences.en: Andrew was in the middle of a manic episode.
sentences.zh: 但在1994年5月22日星期日晚上，他变本加厉了。

sentences.en: He was spiralling out of control.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁离开了米歇尔的住处，前往附近的一栋公寓楼，那里住着米歇尔的前男友。

sentences.en: He had been coming under the attention of local police due to his ever-increasing erratic behaviour.
sentences.zh: 他开始猛砸管理员的房门，要求管理员让他进入那位前男友的公寓。

sentences.en: But on the night of Sunday the 22nd of May 1994,
sentences.zh: 他的借口是什么？

sentences.en: he took things up a notch.
sentences.zh: 他说自己是缉毒组的侦探，刚收到消息称那位前男友的公寓里藏有毒品。

sentences.en: Andrew left Michelle's place and went to a nearby unit block, where a former boyfriend of Michelle's lived.
sentences.zh: 当管理员告诉安德鲁她没有钥匙时，他直接破门而入。

sentences.en: He started bashing down the door of the caretaker's unit, demanding that the caretaker let him into the unit of the old boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 他其实是为了寻找米歇尔声称被前男友偷走的几样东西。

sentences.en: His story?
sentences.zh: 他基本上只是想在米歇尔面前表现一番。

sentences.en: He was a drug squad detective and he had just received information there were drugs stashed in his unit.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁没在公寓里找到失窃物品，但他偷走了对方的吉他和几件夹克。

sentences.en: When the caretaker told Andrew she didn't have a key, he broke down his door.
sentences.zh: 但那位前男友很快就理清了头绪，没过多久，警察就开始寻找安德鲁了。

sentences.en: He was actually there to look for some items that Michelle claimed her old boyfriend had stolen from her.
sentences.zh: 他于次日，即1994年5月23日星期一被捕。

sentences.en: He was basically just trying to impress her.
sentences.zh: 当他回到警察局时，曾有一段时间被独自留在办公桌旁。

sentences.en: Andrew didn't find the stolen items in his unit, but he did steal his guitar and a few jackets.
sentences.zh: 于是他顺手拿走了一个警用领带夹和一枚徽章。

sentences.en: But it didn't take long for the old boyfriend to put it all together, and very soon the police came looking for Andrew.
sentences.zh: 他认为这些东西能帮他向米歇尔兜售他的谎言，让她对他更加崇拜。

sentences.en: He was arrested the next day, Monday the 23rd of May, 1994.
sentences.zh: 他在警局一直待到下午3点45分左右才被释放。

sentences.en: While he was back at the police station, he was left unattended at a desk for a period of time.
sentences.zh: 他在外面徘徊了一会儿，最终打到了一辆出租车。

sentences.en: So he helped himself to a police tie pin and a badge.
sentences.zh: 他跳上车，指示司机前往莫斯曼公园区。

sentences.en: He thought those would come in handy to help sell his story to Michelle and impress her even more.
sentences.zh: 他在下午5点左右到达那里。

sentences.en: He was at the station until about 3.45pm when he was released.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，珀斯遭遇了一场罕见的特大风暴。

sentences.en: He waited around for a while before eventually finding a taxi.
sentences.zh: 狂风大作，伴随着闪电、雷鸣和暴雨。

sentences.en: He jumped in and instructed the driver to head to Mosman Park.
sentences.zh: 这种风暴甚至吹倒了电线杆，导致交通信号灯熄灭。

sentences.en: He got there around 5pm.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉·劳伦斯当时正在她的珠宝店“Flora Metallica”工作。

sentences.en: On that afternoon, Perth was hit by a massive freak storm.
sentences.zh: 那不是一家传统的珠宝店。

sentences.en: There were gale force winds, lightning, thunder and heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 帕姆喜欢将日常用品浸入各种金属中，创造出她自己独特的珠宝风格。

sentences.en: The type of storm that knocked down power poles and blacked out traffic lights.
sentences.zh: 她的店位于莫斯曼公园区的格莱德街购物区，靠近米歇尔的公寓。

sentences.en: Kamala Lawrence was working in her jewellery store called Flora Metallica.
sentences.zh: 在决定转行之前，帕姆曾是一名手术室护士。

sentences.en: It wasn't a traditional type of jewellery store.
sentences.zh: 她与彼得·劳伦斯有着23年的恩爱婚姻，他们有两个女儿，艾米和凯蒂。

sentences.en: Pam liked to dip everyday items into various metals and create her own unique style of jewellery.
sentences.zh: 帕姆是一个友好、活泼的人，总能点亮整个房间。

sentences.en: Her shop was located in the Glide Street shopping area in Mosman Park, near Michelle's unit.
sentences.zh: 莫斯曼公园区是珀斯一个主要为富裕阶层的郊区，位于中央商务区西南方向约11公里（约5英里）处。

sentences.en: Pam was a theatre nurse before deciding on the career change.
sentences.zh: 西临印度洋，东靠天鹅河，这里拥有不少宏伟昂贵的住宅和富有的居民。

sentences.en: She had been lovingly married to Peter Lawrence for 23 years and they had two daughters, Amy and Katie.
sentences.zh: 尽管这里也有一些政府公屋，住着许多不太体面的人。

sentences.en: Pam was a friendly, bubbly person who could light up a room.
sentences.zh: 他们大多失业且有毒瘾，靠犯罪来维持恶习。

sentences.en: Mosman Park is a mostly affluent suburb of Perth, 11 kilometres or roughly five miles southwest of the CBD.
sentences.zh: 格莱德街附近的商店最近多次成为入室盗窃的目标。

sentences.en: With the Indian Ocean to the west and the Swan River to the east, it has its fair share of grand, expensive houses and well-to-do residents.
sentences.zh: “Flora Metallica”虽然没被盗过，但有人曾用砖头砸碎过前窗。

sentences.en: Although it did have its share of government housing units where a lot of the residents were less desirable types.
sentences.zh: 最近的犯罪活动促使帕姆叮嘱员工，如果有人闯入或在店里试图抢劫，直接把他们想要的东西给他们就行。

sentences.en: Most were unemployed and addicted to drugs, turning to crime to fuel their habits.
sentences.zh: 钱财和物质不值得为此受伤。

sentences.en: The shops around Glide Street had been the targets of several recent break-ins.
sentences.zh: 那天确实有一名员工杰基·巴斯登和帕姆一起工作，但她在下午3点就下班了。

sentences.en: Flora Metallica hadn't been broken into but somebody had thrown a brick through the front window.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，帕姆就独自一人了。

sentences.en: The recent criminal activity led Pam to instruct her staff members that if anyone broke in or tried to rob them while they were there, just to hand over whatever they wanted.
sentences.zh: 同样是在那天下午，5月23日，13岁的凯瑟琳·巴斯登被她的祖母从学校接走。凯瑟琳是杰基·巴斯登的女儿。

sentences.en: Money and material objects weren't worth getting heard over.
sentences.zh: 杰基在“Flora Metallica”与帕姆一起工作。

sentences.en: Pam did have a staff member working with her that day, Jackie Basden, but she finished at 3pm.
sentences.zh: 为了回家，凯瑟琳的祖母必须开车直接经过那家店。

sentences.en: After that,
sentences.zh: 她们当时正好被堵在店外的红绿灯处。

sentences.en: Pam was by herself.
sentences.zh: 当凯瑟琳从车里往店里看时，她吃了一惊，看到一个陌生的白人男子站在柜台后面。

sentences.en: Still on that same afternoon, the 23rd of May, 13-year-old Catherine Basden had been picked up from school by her grandmother, Catherine, the daughter of Jackie Barsden,
sentences.zh: 她描述那人大约30到35岁，中等身材，留着淡淡的橙色胡须，身高六英尺，看起来好像戴着头巾。

sentences.en: who worked at Flora Metallica with Pam.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳一直盯着那个男人看，他最终与她对视了一眼，随后立即蹲到了柜台后面。

sentences.en: In order to get home, Catherine's grandmother had to drive directly past the store.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳以前从未在店里见过这个人。

sentences.en: They actually got stopped at traffic lights directly outside.
sentences.zh: 她觉得很奇怪，特意看了看车上的时钟。

sentences.en: Catherine got a shock when she looked inside the shop from the car and saw a strange Caucasian man standing behind the counter.
sentences.zh: 时间是五点零二分。

sentences.en: She described him as being 30 to 35 years old, medium build, a slight orange beard, six feet tall, and it looked like he was wearing a bandana.
sentences.zh: 她回家后告诉了妈妈杰基。

sentences.en: Catherine kept staring at the man and he eventually made eye contact with her, after which he immediately crouched down behind the counter.
sentences.zh: 杰基觉得这听起来很奇怪，于是拿起电话想打给帕姆确认她是否安全。

sentences.en: Catherine had never seen the man in the shop before.
sentences.zh: 但随后她改变了主意，觉得可能没什么事。

sentences.en: She thought it was strange and made sure to look at the clock in the car.
sentences.zh: 彼得·劳伦斯当时正和他的一个女儿待在家里。

sentences.en: The time was two minutes past five.
sentences.zh: 他担心妻子帕姆还没下班回家。

sentences.en: She told her mum Jackie when she got home.
sentences.zh: 他在六点一刻给店里打了电话，想问她打算什么时候回家。

sentences.en: Jackie thought it sounded strange, so she picked up the phone to call Pam to make sure she was okay.
sentences.zh: 当帕姆没有接听时，他决定最好亲自去店里看看她。

sentences.en: But then she changed her mind, deciding it was probably nothing.
sentences.zh: 下午6点39分，有人拨打了紧急服务电话。

sentences.en: Peter Lawrence was at home with one of his daughters.
sentences.zh: 一名女性遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: He was concerned that his wife Pam hadn't returned home from work yet.
sentences.zh: 救护车被派往莫斯曼公园区的“Flora Metallica”珠宝店。

sentences.en: He called the store at quarter past six to see when she planned on getting home.
sentences.zh: 彼得·劳伦斯走进店里，发现帕姆倒在血泊中，头部受了重伤。

sentences.en: When Pam didn't answer, he decided he had better go down and check on her.
sentences.zh: 当救护车和警察赶到时，彼得正跪在妻子身边试图救助她，身上也沾满了鲜血。

sentences.en: At 6.39pm, a call was made to emergency services.
sentences.zh: 帕姆失血量达数升。

sentences.zh: 在审判中，你表现得自信、果断，并表现出明显的证据，证明你是一个操纵性强的人，如果需要，随时准备撒谎、欺骗、偷窃和诈骗。

sentences.zh: 你去商店是为了入室盗窃，但当你意识到自己会被认出来时，你惊慌失措，用一把沉重的扳手反复击打帕梅拉·劳伦斯。

sentences.zh: 安德鲁站起来尖叫道：我没有。

sentences.zh: 依赖于他们所谓的安德鲁供词中只有凶手才知道的15件事。

sentences.en: But as you've heard, some of these details were given to Andrew, like the sidcrome wrench.

sentences.en: The three appeal judges listened to both sides and retired to reach their verdict, which came three months later and it was unanimous.
sentences.zh: 三位上诉法官听取了双方的陈述并退庭进行裁决，三个月后裁决结果出来了，是一致通过。

sentences.en: Andrew's appeal
sentences.zh: 安德鲁的上诉

sentences.zh: 驳回上诉，维持原判。

sentences.zh: 虽然裁决确实对警方提出了警告，

sentences.zh: 即今后不得再使用未经录音的供词，但安德鲁案的审判结果不会改变。

sentences.en: Their ruling did state there were some unsatisfactory aspects of Andrew's case but they were happy there was no miscarriage of justice.
sentences.zh: 裁决书确实指出安德鲁案中存在一些令人不满的地方，但他们认为并没有造成冤假错案。

sentences.en: The ruling meant that there was one court left to go, the High Court.
sentences.zh: 这意味着只剩下一个法院可以上诉了，那就是高等法院。

sentences.en: But you couldn't just take any old case to the High Court.
sentences.zh: 但你不能随随便便把任何旧案都带到高等法院。

sentences.en: You first had to convince three judges that the appeal had grounds to be heard in the High Court, sort of like an application process.
sentences.zh: 你首先得说服三名法官，证明该上诉有理由在高等法院审理，这有点像是一个申请程序。

sentences.en: Generally, the High Court is only interested in severe miscarriages of justice or matters of national importance.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，高等法院只对严重的冤假错案或具有国家重要性的案件感兴趣。

sentences.en: Andrew's barrister failed to convince them.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁的辩护律师没能说服他们。

sentences.en: The case wouldn't be heard in the High Court.
sentences.zh: 此案不会在高等法院审理。

sentences.en: It was done.
sentences.zh: 一切都结束了。

sentences.en: Andrew was imprisoned for life.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁被判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: Andrew struggled to cope with the ruling, demanding to take a lie detector test, even demanding to be injected with truth serum,
sentences.zh: 安德鲁难以接受这一裁决，要求进行测谎，甚至要求注射吐真剂，

sentences.en: not knowing these weren't actually options.
sentences.zh: 却不知道这些根本不是选项。

sentences.en: As time went on, he started to believe he was the victim of a big conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他开始相信自己是一场巨大阴谋的受害者。

sentences.en: They must be trying to brainwash him.
sentences.zh: 他们一定是在试图对他洗脑。

sentences.en: The real killer was a powerful man, so Andrew was set up as a patsy.
sentences.zh: 真正的凶手是个有权势的人，所以安德鲁被陷害成了替罪羊。

sentences.en: He started to believe everyone was in on it.
sentences.zh: 他开始相信每个人都参与其中。

sentences.en: The real murderer, the police, the lawyers, the judges, the prison guards, everyone.
sentences.zh: 真正的凶手、警察、律师、法官、狱警，所有人。

sentences.en: The long interviews he had were actually brainwashing sessions designed to convince him he was responsible.
sentences.zh: 他接受的那些长时间审讯实际上是洗脑过程，旨在让他相信自己有罪。

sentences.en: He even went to the prison library, trying to find anything he could about brainwashing and hypnosis, convinced this must be the answer.
sentences.zh: 他甚至去监狱图书馆，试图寻找任何关于洗脑和催眠的资料，坚信这一定是答案。

sentences.en: The idea continued to grow in his head.
sentences.zh: 这个想法在他脑海中不断滋长。

sentences.en: He started to see the prison as a brainwashing facility.
sentences.zh: 他开始把监狱看作是一个洗脑设施。

sentences.en: The lights were actually cameras, recording his every move, the live feed of which was being sent back to Detective Capel.
sentences.zh: 灯光其实是摄像头，记录着他的一举一动，实时画面被传回给卡佩尔警探。

sentences.en: The distress alarm in his cell was a speaker where messages were whispered to him in his sleep.
sentences.zh: 牢房里的紧急报警器是一个扬声器，在他睡觉时向他低语传递信息。

sentences.en: He saw the other prisoners as actors.
sentences.zh: 他把其他囚犯看作是演员。

sentences.en: This was their job, to come here and convince him he was in prison, when really they were part of the brainwashing conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的工作，来到这里让他相信自己身陷囹圄，而实际上他们是洗脑阴谋的一部分。

sentences.en: He became obsessed with the idea, refusing to speak to any other prisoners and even cutting off all visits from his family.
sentences.zh: 他沉迷于这个想法，拒绝与任何其他囚犯交谈，甚至切断了与家人的所有探视。

sentences.en: He put up a sign in his cell.
sentences.zh: 他在牢房里贴了一个告示。

sentences.en: My name is Andrew Mark Mallard.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是安德鲁·马克·马拉德。

sentences.en: I will not speak to any police or member of the justice system prison's department or any other authority without proper legal representation.
sentences.zh: 在没有适当法律代表的情况下，我不会与任何警察、司法系统监狱部门成员或任何其他权威机构交谈。

sentences.en: I have nothing to say.
sentences.zh: 我无可奉告。

sentences.en: Despite his delusional state, Andrew was known as a passive, well-behaved prisoner.
sentences.zh: 尽管处于妄想状态，安德鲁还是被认为是一个被动、表现良好的囚犯。

sentences.en: Andrew's parents, Roy and Grace, and his sister Jackie were convinced he was innocent.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁的父母罗伊和格蕾丝，以及他的妹妹杰基，都坚信他是无辜的。

sentences.en: Roy dedicated himself to studying court transcripts, witness accounts and law books to try and find a hole in the case.
sentences.zh: 罗伊致力于研究法庭记录、证人陈述和法律书籍，试图找出案件中的漏洞。

sentences.en: He was certain the story didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 他确信这个故事根本说不通。

sentences.en: Something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 有什么地方不对劲。

sentences.zh: 加上他的洗脑阴谋论，他不想再让他多操心。

sentences.en: Roy died less than four weeks later.
sentences.zh: 不到四周后，罗伊去世了。

sentences.zh: 由于切断了所有探视，安德鲁已经多年没见过家人了。

sentences.zh: 安德鲁不相信她。

sentences.en: He was still running with his conspiracy theory and he believed that they had now gotten to his family.

sentences.en: That it was a story designed to finally break him.

sentences.zh: 他说，别担心妈妈，我知道你被要求这么说，告诉爸爸我知道他很好。

sentences.en: It suddenly became clear to Andrew, this was real.
sentences.zh: 他不在洗脑设施里。

sentences.en: It wasn't a conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 开关被拨动了。

sentences.en: He wasn't in a brainwashing facility.

sentences.en: The switch was flicked.
sentences.zh: 他那些妄想的胡言乱语消失了。

sentences.en: Andrew started to come back.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁想要配合精神科医生，证明他是无辜的。

sentences.en: Gone were his delusional ramblings.
sentences.zh: 经过几个月的治疗，他的病情大为好转，被送回了监狱。

sentences.en: Andrew wanted to cooperate with the psychiatrist and prove he was innocent.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁向他的母亲和妹妹道歉，说那个洗脑阴谋论是他唯一能用来合理化发生在他身上的一切的方式。

sentences.en: After a few months of treatment, his condition had greatly improved and he was sent back to prison.
sentences.zh: 杰基给科琳打了电话，告诉了她这个好消息。

sentences.en: Andrew apologised to his mum and to his sister, saying that conspiracy brainwashing theory was the only way he could rationalise what had happened to him.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁准备好了。

sentences.en: Jackie called Colleen and told her the good news.
sentences.zh: 这是一个漫长的过程。

sentences.en: Andrew was ready.
sentences.zh: 科琳在安德鲁的辩护律师和许多其他人的帮助下，研究了这个案子四年。

sentences.en: It was a long process.
sentences.zh: 但他们找不到他们需要的东西。

sentences.en: Colleen worked on the case for four years with the help of Andrew's barrister and many others.
sentences.zh: 他们没有发现任何新的证据，所以没有理由进行新的上诉。

sentences.en: But they couldn't find what they needed.
sentences.zh: 科琳决定接触一位意想不到的盟友。

sentences.en: They hadn't uncovered any fresh evidence, so there was no grounds for a new appeal
sentences.zh: 约翰·奎格利是一位知名律师，曾为警察工会工作了25年，

sentences.en: Colleen decided to approach an unlikely ally
sentences.zh: 为被指控不当行为的警官辩护，他很少输掉官司。

sentences.en: John Quigley was a well-known lawyer who spent 25 years working with the police union
sentences.zh: 他的声誉非常卓越。

sentences.en: Defending police officers accused of wrongdoing He rarely lost a case
sentences.zh: 被称为你能找到的最好的律师之一。

sentences.en: His reputation was exceptional
sentences.zh: 他也是一个个性鲜明的人，喜欢聚光灯，喜欢镜头。

sentences.en: Known as one of the best lawyers you could get
sentences.zh: 科琳从她做犯罪报道的日子里就知道这一点。

sentences.en: He was also a big personality who loved the limelight and loved the camera
sentences.zh: 但奎格利最近辞去了律师职务，投身政界，成为了工党的后座议员。

sentences.en: Colleen knew this from her crime reporting days.
sentences.zh: 在研究这个案子的四年里，科琳换了工作。

sentences.en: But Quigley had recently quit law and had taken up politics, becoming a Labour Party backbencher.
sentences.zh: 碰巧她现在为一家报道政治的报纸工作。

sentences.en: During the four years she had been working on the case, Colleen had changed jobs.
sentences.zh: 奎格利对警察的程序和做法了如指掌。

sentences.en: It just so happened she was now working for a newspaper covering politics.
sentences.zh: 这就是他成为接触对象的最佳人选，但这很有风险，25年为警官辩护让他建立了一些稳固的关系和人脉，他是唯一一个被授予警察工会终身会员资格的非警务人员。

sentences.en: Quigley knew everything there was to know about police procedures and practices.
sentences.zh: 科琳接触了他，让他知道她坚信有一个无辜的人被关在监狱里，还有什么比帮助一个无辜的人出狱更能开启政治生涯的呢。

sentences.en: it's what made him such a good person to approach but it was risky 25 years of defending police
sentences.zh: 奎格利没有做出任何承诺，但他告诉科琳他会看看这个案子，然后再回复她。

sentences.en: officers had developed some solid relationships and contacts he was the only non-police officer
sentences.zh: 他没花多久就发现了一个问题。

sentences.en: to be given a life membership of the police union colleen approached him and let him know
sentences.zh: 那是第一次审讯后发生的事情，当时安德鲁被指控袭击警察。

sentences.en: she strongly believed there was an innocent man behind bars what better way to start a career in politics, helping get an innocent man out of prison.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁当时无家可归。

sentences.en: Quigley didn't make any promises but he told Colleen he would have a look at the case and get back to her.
sentences.zh: 一个人如果无处可去，却被保释，这是非常不寻常的。

sentences.en: It didn't take him long to find a problem.
sentences.zh: 他将这一事实与布兰登警探的证词进行了对比，

sentences.en: It was what happened after the first interview when Andrew was charged with assaulting police.
sentences.zh: 布兰登一周后在沃伦逮捕了安德鲁，并进行了第二次审讯。

sentences.en: Andrew was homeless at the time.
sentences.zh: 布兰登说他只是开车到处转转，偶然在公园里看到了安德鲁，所以就在沃伦逮捕了他。

sentences.en: It was very unusual for somebody to be released on bail if they had nowhere to go.
sentences.zh: 奎格利很快就把这些拼凑起来了。

sentences.en: He compared this fact with the evidence of Detective Brandon
sentences.zh: 他意识到安德鲁被释放是因为他们在进行卧底行动，而布兰登并不是偶然开车经过公园看到他的。

sentences.en: who arrested Andrew on the warren a week later and conducted the second interview.
sentences.zh: 他们一直都知道他在哪里。

sentences.en: Brandom said he was just driving around and by chance happened to see Andrew in the park so he arrested him on the warren.
sentences.zh: 不寻常的是，当时有卧底行动，但在审判中根本没有提及。

sentences.en: Quigley was able to put it together pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 接触奎格利得到了回报。

sentences.en: He realised Andrew was released because they were running an undercover operation and Brandom didn't just happen to drive past him in the park.
sentences.zh: 这些是他注意到的别人没看到的事情。

sentences.en: They knew where he was the entire time.
sentences.zh: 奎格利推测可能还有更多被隐藏的东西。

sentences.en: It was unusual that there was an undercover operation and it wasn't mentioned in the trial at all.
sentences.zh: 他决定亲自会见法医病理学家库克医生。

sentences.en: The approach to Quigley had paid off.
sentences.zh: 奎格利问他是如何确定扳手是凶器的。

sentences.en: These were things that stood out for him that the others just didn't see.
sentences.zh: 库克医生说他不知道。

sentences.en: And Quigley assumed that there was probably more that had been hidden.
sentences.zh: 他告诉奎格利，他曾对负责此案的警探和检察官说过同样的话：

sentences.en: He decided to meet personally with the forensic pathologist Dr Cook.
sentences.zh: 我很难相信扳手会造成那些伤害。

sentences.en: Quigley asked him how it came to be that a wrench was determined to be the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 奎格利向他展示了安德鲁画的西德·克罗姆扳手的草图。

sentences.en: Dr. Cook said he had no idea.
sentences.zh: 库克医生以前从未见过它。

sentences.en: He told Quigley the same thing he says he told the detectives in charge of the case and the prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 这足以让事情开始运转了。

sentences.en: I find it hard to believe a wrench could have caused those injuries.
sentences.zh: 奎格利利用他的人脉获得了检方档案。

sentences.en: Quigley showed him the sketch that Andrew had drawn of the Sid Crome wrench.
sentences.zh: 当时他们手头只有法庭记录。

sentences.en: Dr. Cook had never seen it before.
sentences.zh: 令他们惊讶的是，早在1994年就进行了测试，看看扳手会在猪头上造成什么样的伤口。

sentences.en: This was enough for the ball to start rolling.
sentences.zh: 伤口与帕姆遭受的伤口不同。

sentences.en: Quigley used his political connections to be given the prosecution file.
sentences.zh: 这项测试从未向辩方披露，也没有在审判中提出。

sentences.en: All they had at that point were the court transcripts.
sentences.zh: 检方档案也证实了奎格利已经推断出的事实，即确实存在卧底行动。

sentences.en: It surprised them to see that tests had been done back in 1994, to see what wounds a wrench made on a pig's head.
sentences.zh: 审判至今已经过去了好几年。

sentences.en: The wounds were different to the wounds suffered by Pam.
sentences.zh: 检察官卡姆·贝茨，当时处理的是他首批高调案件之一，现在是一位声誉卓著、备受尊敬的检察官。

sentences.en: This test was never disclosed to the defence or brought up at the trial.
sentences.zh: 约翰·麦克基尼，当时是该州最高检察官，并批准警探进行指控，现在是一名在职最高法院法官。

sentences.en: The prosecution file also confirmed what Quigley had already worked out anyway, that there was an undercover operation.
sentences.zh: 谢维尔和卡波恩警探现在是助理警察局长。

sentences.en: Several years had now passed since the trial.
sentences.zh: 逮捕安德鲁并进行第二次审讯的布兰登警探，现在是一名警司。

sentences.en: The prosecutor Cam Bates, who was in one of his first high-profile cases, was now a highly respected prosecutor with a good reputation.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，奎格利的说法遭到了抵制。

sentences.en: John McKechnie, who was the top prosecutor in the state at the time and who gave the detectives the go-ahead to charge, was now a serving Supreme
sentences.zh: 头条新闻写道，奎格利正试图利用非披露的技术性问题让一个恶毒的杀人犯逃脱惩罚。

sentences.en: Court judge.
sentences.zh: 负责此案的警官和检察官办公室坚称对安德鲁的指控证据确凿。

sentences.en: Detectives Sherville and Caporn were now assistant police commissioners.
sentences.zh: 他做出了确凿的供词，陪审团确信他就是凶手，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Detective Brandom, who arrested Andrew and conducted the second interview, was now a superintendent.
sentences.zh: 但现在已经揭露了足够多的证据，足以将此案发回刑事上诉法院。

sentences.en: Not surprisingly, there was resistance to what Quigley was saying.
sentences.zh: 检方决心对抗上诉。

sentences.en: Headlines read that Quigley was trying to get a vicious murderer off the hook on a non-disclosure technicality.
sentences.zh: 他们承认，是的，他们应该披露所有信息，但他们坚称这只是疏忽，不会影响审判结果。

sentences.en: Officers in charge of the case and the prosecutor's office maintained that the case against Andrew was strong.
sentences.zh: 知名大律师马尔科姆·麦卡斯克，他的信让科琳对这个案子产生了兴趣，现在正在为安德鲁辩护。

sentences.en: He had made a solid confession and a jury was convinced beyond a reasonable doubt he was the killer.

sentences.en: And because the case was back before the Court of Criminal Appeal and full disclosure had been made, there were a few more issues that came up.
sentences.zh: 由于案件回到了刑事上诉法院，且已进行了全面披露，因此又出现了一些新问题。

sentences.en: Michelle, the girl Andrew was living with at the time of the murder, was made to give several different statements to police.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁在谋杀案发生时与之同居的女孩米歇尔，被迫向警方提供了几份不同的陈述。

sentences.en: Each one's slightly different adding or taking out little details to better fit the theory that Andrew was responsible.
sentences.zh: 每一份陈述都略有不同，通过增减一些细节，使其更符合安德鲁是凶手的推论。

sentences.en: Only her last statement was given to the defence.
sentences.zh: 只有她最后的一份陈述被提供给了辩方。

sentences.en: Catherine Barsden, the 13-year-old witness who saw the suspicious man in the shop, also made a sketch of the man she saw as soon as she got home,
sentences.zh: 13岁的目击者凯瑟琳·巴斯登在店里看到了那个可疑男子，她一回到家就画了一张男子的素描，

sentences.en: and she wrote a statement out herself,
sentences.zh: 并亲自写了一份陈述，

sentences.en: different to what was later presented at court.
sentences.zh: 这与后来在法庭上提交的内容不同。

sentences.en: Catherine had also failed to pick Andrew out of a photo line-up, and she didn't identify him in court as the man she saw.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳在照片辨认中也没能认出安德鲁，在法庭上她也没有指认他就是她看到的那个男人。

sentences.en: It was found that a forensic report had also been amended.
sentences.zh: 调查发现，一份法医报告也被修改过。

sentences.en: The amended version was the one supplied to the defence and presented as evidence at the trial.
sentences.zh: 修改后的版本被提供给了辩方，并作为证据在审判中出示。

sentences.en: It was amended to remove the part that said there was no trace of salt water on Andrew's clothing.
sentences.zh: 它被修改的部分删除了关于安德鲁衣服上没有盐水痕迹的内容。

sentences.en: If you remember back to Andrew's theory on the crime, he said that the killer washed his clothes in the salt water because it fucks with the forensics.
sentences.zh: 如果你还记得安德鲁对这起犯罪的推论，他说凶手是在盐水中清洗衣服的，因为这会干扰法医鉴定。

sentences.en: As they were relying on his third-person rants as a confession, it didn't look good if there was no blood and no traces of salt water on his clothes.
sentences.zh: 由于他们将他那些第三人称的胡言乱语作为供词，如果他的衣服上没有血迹也没有盐水痕迹，这看起来就不太妙了。

sentences.en: but if there was no mention of the salt water not being present, Bates could still give that theory to the jury.
sentences.zh: 但如果没有提到盐水不存在这一点，贝茨仍然可以向陪审团提出那个推论。

sentences.en: Andrew washed his clothes in the river, that's why there was no blood.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁在河里洗了衣服，所以才没有血迹。

sentences.en: So Andrew's defence team were arguing that evidence was withheld and statements were changed in order to make the case look a whole lot stronger than what it was.
sentences.zh: 因此，安德鲁的辩护团队认为，证据被隐瞒，陈述被篡改，目的是为了让案件看起来比实际情况更有说服力。

sentences.en: The case was heard in the Court of Criminal Appeal before three Supreme Court judges.
sentences.zh: 该案在刑事上诉法院由三名最高法院法官审理。

sentences.en: On the 3rd of December 2003, they made their ruling which was again unanimous.
sentences.zh: 2003年12月3日，他们再次做出了全体一致的裁决。

sentences.en: Appeal dismissed, conviction upheld.
sentences.zh: 上诉驳回，维持原判。

sentences.en: To keep it simple basically they agreed with the prosecution yes there were clearly non-disclosure issues
sentences.zh: 简单来说，他们同意检方的观点，即确实存在未披露证据的问题，

sentences.en: but no those non-disclosures wouldn't have affected the outcome of the trial.
sentences.zh: 但这些未披露的内容并不会影响审判结果。

sentences.en: Neither Sherville or Caporn were called as witnesses by the prosecution in the appeal
sentences.zh: 在上诉中，检方没有传唤谢维尔或卡波恩作为证人，

sentences.en: meaning the defence could not cross-examine them.
sentences.zh: 这意味着辩方无法对他们进行交叉盘问。

sentences.en: On the 27th of October 2004 Andrew's defence team presented their case to the High Court.
sentences.zh: 2004年10月27日，安德鲁的辩护团队向高等法院提交了案件。

sentences.en: Again it was initially like an application process.
sentences.zh: 同样，这最初就像是一个申请过程。

sentences.en: This time they were successful.
sentences.zh: 这一次他们成功了。

sentences.en: The judges granted special leave for the High Court to hear the appeal but there was still a long road ahead.
sentences.zh: 法官批准了高等法院审理此案的特别许可，但前方仍有漫长的道路。

sentences.en: All that meant was that they got their foot in the door.
sentences.zh: 这一切意味着他们终于迈出了第一步。

sentences.en: It would be another year before the case was actually heard.
sentences.zh: 距离案件真正开庭审理还有一年时间。

sentences.en: But their day in the
sentences.zh: 但他们终于等到了在

sentences.en: High Court finally came and five judges sat on the panel to hear the appeal.
sentences.zh: 高等法院出庭的那一天，五名法官组成的合议庭听取了上诉。

sentences.en: After considering all the evidence and all the issues around the case, they reached a decision.
sentences.zh: 在考虑了所有证据和案件相关的所有问题后，他们做出了决定。

sentences.en: And again, it was unanimous.
sentences.zh: 而且再次达成了一致。

sentences.en: Conviction quashed.
sentences.zh: 撤销定罪。

sentences.en: A retrial was ordered.
sentences.zh: 下令重审。

sentences.en: They believed there had been a miscarriage of justice.
sentences.zh: 他们认为此案存在司法不公。

sentences.en: Shortly after the High Court ruling, the Corruption and Crime Commission started investigating allegations of misconduct by the lead detectives and the prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 高等法院裁决后不久，腐败与犯罪委员会开始调查首席侦探和检察官的不当行为指控。

sentences.en: The prosecution initially didn't back down, declaring they had every intention of pursuing the retrial.
sentences.zh: 检方最初并未退缩，声称他们完全打算继续进行重审。

sentences.en: But their attitude changed when a judge ruled that those unrecorded and unsigned confessions wouldn't be admissible in the second trial.
sentences.zh: 但当法官裁定那些未记录且未签字的供词在第二次审判中不可采信时，他们的态度发生了转变。

sentences.en: With that information in mind, the prosecution elected not to pursue a retry.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一信息，检方选择不再进行重审。

sentences.en: They took a parting shot, saying the only reason they weren't pursuing the case is because vital evidence was ruled inadmissible and that Andrew remained their prime suspect.
sentences.zh: 他们临走前还补了一枪，称他们不再追究此案的唯一原因是关键证据被裁定为不可采信，且安德鲁仍然是他们的头号嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The police agreed, saying the case would remain closed.
sentences.zh: 警方表示同意，称此案将保持结案状态。

sentences.en: Andrew was their man, but he had just been let off on a technicality.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁就是他们认定的凶手，但他只是因为技术性原因被释放了。

sentences.en: After being locked up for 12 years,
sentences.zh: 在被关押12年后，

sentences.en: Andrew was free.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁重获自由。

sentences.en: Just after Andrew's release a blood splatter expert was in Perth testifying in an unrelated trial.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁获释后不久，一位血迹喷溅专家正在珀斯为另一起无关的案件作证。

sentences.en: He studied the photos of bloody clothing that had been taken after Pam's murder.
sentences.zh: 他研究了帕姆谋杀案后拍摄的血衣照片。

sentences.en: Based on those photos he formed an opinion on who killed Pam.
sentences.zh: 根据这些照片，他形成了关于谁杀害了帕姆的观点。

sentences.en: His report wasn't good news for Pam's husband, Peter Lawrence.
sentences.zh: 他的报告对帕姆的丈夫彼得·劳伦斯来说不是好消息。

sentences.en: Despite the police saying the case would remain closed, public pressure mounted, and they were forced to reopen it and have another look.
sentences.zh: 尽管警方称此案将保持结案，但公众压力越来越大，他们被迫重新开启调查并再次审视。

sentences.en: They formed a squad to re-examine every piece of evidence in the case.
sentences.zh: 他们组建了一个小组，重新检查了案中的每一项证据。

sentences.en: New technology was now available that didn't exist 12 years earlier, and it was hoped that this new technology might help uncover new information.
sentences.zh: 现在有了12年前不存在的新技术，人们希望这项新技术能有助于发现新的信息。

sentences.en: And it did.
sentences.zh: 事实确实如此。

sentences.en: A partial palm print was fed through the computer system, and it quickly produced a match.
sentences.zh: 一个部分掌纹被输入计算机系统，很快就匹配成功了。

sentences.en: In July 1994, just seven weeks after Pam's murder,
sentences.zh: 1994年7月，也就是帕姆遇害仅七周后，

sentences.en: an English backpacker, Simon Rockford, was arrested for the murder of his girlfriend,
sentences.zh: 一名英国背包客西蒙·洛克福德因谋杀其女友而被捕，

sentences.en: Brigida Dickens.
sentences.zh: 布里吉达·狄更斯。
